description: Hand corrections to the trust's own hut and campsite records, applied by the build on top of the KMZ. Each one is keyed by the record's ArcGIS GlobalID, names the record as the trust publishes it, and says why and on what evidence. The build fails if a correction no longer matches the record it was written for. routeNames corrects misspelt section, segment and crossing names by exact match.

sites.reason: The trust publishes this address in the site's phone field. It is an email address, so it is shown as the site's email contact instead of as a phone number.
The park's own name is Whanganui River Top 10 Holiday Park, and the city's official name is Whanganui (NZ Gazetteer place 7006).
Renamed: the park's own site says "Formerly Lake Tekapo Motels and Holiday Park", at the same address and phone number. The trust's website link redirects there.
Capitalisation: DOC's own page names it Bay of Many Coves campsite.
Macron: the official name is Pākiri (NZ Gazetteer place 35107), and the park spells its own name Pākiri Beach Holiday Park.
Macron: the official name of the forest is Puketī Forest (NZ Gazetteer place 54972), and DOC's own page names the hut Puketī Forest Hut.
Macron: Puketī as in the official Puketī Forest (NZ Gazetteer place 54972); DOC's own page names it Puketī Recreation Area campsite.
Macron: the hut is at the head of the Tīmaru River, Otago (official, NZ Gazetteer place 44068), and DOC's own page names it Top Tīmaru Hut. Not the Canterbury city, which is officially unmacronned.

Consistency with Pāhautea Hut, the record beside it. The NZ Gazetteer has no official name here (only an unofficial recorded Pahautea, place 58563), so this follows DOC, whose own page names the site Pāhautea Hut Campsite.
